title: feat(spec)!: action locations say what an action acts on
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoM3531xPi2L3EUw2ayzmaM3)_

Part of #36495

## What changes

An action's `locations` now say what the action acts on, not the part of the page it sits in. `ACTION_LOCATIONS` is `list`, `record`, `record_page`, `record_row`, `record_related`, `record_section`. The page-part words `list_toolbar`, `list_item`, `record_header` and `record_more` are retired.

- `record` is new: the action acts on one record, so it is drawn on the record page's header and in each list row's menu.
- The record header's ⋯ fold, which `record_more` used to say, is the action's `component: 'action:menu'`.
- Which actions are buttons and in what order stays the object's `actionLayout`.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #37895

## ADR-0087 conversion `action-locations-acted-on` (lossless)

FROM → TO. Each action is drawn in exactly the places it was drawn before:

- `list_toolbar` → `list`
- `list_item` → `record_row`
- `record_header` / `record_more` → `record_page`
- `record_header` or `record_more` beside `list_item` → `record`
- `record_more` without `record_header` → `record_page` + `component: 'action:menu'`
- A component's single `location` (`record:quick_actions`, `action:group`, `action:bar`) is mapped the same way.

The conversion is retired from the load path from day one, as every protocol-19 entry is. An old word is refused at authoring, and the refusal names the word to write instead. Stored items, built artifacts and `os migrate meta --from 18` replay the conversion. It leaves a TODO and changes nothing in three cases that have no lossless rewrite:

- a `record_more`-only action that is also on `list_toolbar`; there are 0 in this repo
- a component whose `location` is `record_more`
- an `action:group` at `record_header` with a `record_more`-only member

The semantic entry `action-locations-page-parts-retired` carries the step into the protocol-19 upgrade guide.

## Readers

- `@object-ui/types`:
  - `actionRendersAt` reads `record` as covering `record_page` and `record_row`.
  - The new `actionFoldedIntoMenu` tells whether an action is folded into the ⋯.
  - `arrangedHeaderActions` pins and unpins through `component`.
- `page:header` sends every folded action to its ⋯. Every other `record_page` action takes the inline budget.
- `record:quick_actions` at `record_page` leaves folded actions out.
- The related list reads `record` as a row action.
- The record-scoped checks in core and runtime (`isRecordScopedAction`, `requiresRecord`) accept `record`.
- Studio:
  - The action inspector and the `record:quick_actions` location dropdown offer `record`.
  - The action preview draws the fold as "record_page · ⋯".
- Lint: the record-page header, related-list and action-layout rules read the new words. The related-list hint now groups locations that draw the same thing, which keeps the one-line fix under 200 characters.
- Declarations under `packages/**`, `examples/**` and `ui/**`, plus `content/docs/**`, use the new words. The generated references, `sdui.manifest.json` and the component reference pages are regenerated.

## Not moved

- #37895: the `skills/**` teaching. It is Blocked-by this card.
  - ⚠ Two derived gates are red on this PR until #37895 PR 1 lands. That PR is skills-only and lands before this one; it makes 9 skills sites compile on both vocabularies.
  - `check:skill-examples` fails on 8 `os:check` examples: `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md:189` and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md:69,96,180,205,239`.
  - `check:skill-served-sections` fails on the JSON fence in `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` § Actions.
  - After PR 1 merges, main is merged here and both gates are re-run.
- HotCRM's declarations ride the HotCRM pin bump.
- `docs/qa/**` checklist prose and the recorded build `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json` keep the old words. Both are outside the card's file surface, and the recorded build is replayed through the conversion.

## Size

417 files, +2308/−1624 (3932 changed lines). This is over 3000, so it is a class (c) landing.
